youtube.title: Screenshot Your Local Services Ads Reports Before the Google Ads Move (HVAC, Pest, Roofing)
youtube.description:
Local Services Ads reports for contractors: screenshot them before the move.
Google's help page says your Local Services Ads performance reports will not transition to Google Ads, and manual bidding (such as setting a maximum cost per lead) is no longer supported there. It says you'll be able to download historical reports soon; until then it says to take screenshots before migrating ("Local Services Ads transition to Performance Max campaigns with pay-per-lead goals," Google Ads Help, read Nov 7, 2026).

What to do this week:
1. Screenshot every Local Services Ads report you have.
2. Write your max per lead beside them.

Send this to whoever runs your Google ads.
Next lesson: another owner problem from the trade forums, told start to finish.
Free cost per lead calculator for trade owners: https://proofnotfluff.com/cost-per-lead-calculator/
